nodes.label: Exe-relative resource resolution defect
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - c1-rust-resource-path-resolution [ses_f1acfb446ffewjvdZK8GfLaOBj].md:L2744] `/usr/lib/snipset` vs `/usr/bin` is a hard split, so the parent-join never lands. `std::fs::read` fails, `.ok()` discards it, all six `OnceLock`s stay empty, and `play_audio_feedback` / `play_clipboard_sound` / `play_toggle_sound` each hit `if let Some(...)` and return silently. Windows is the only platform where this code was ever exercised, which is why it survived.
